title: Evaluating Deep Multivariate Imputation Models on Wearable Device Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.24436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wearable device data enables continuous health monitoring, but suffers from structured missingness: features sharing a physical sensor drop out together. Deep imputation methods such as BRITS and SAITS have seen limited evaluation on multimodal physiological data under realistic missingness, and existing benchmarks use random-point holdout protocols that incorrectly assume missingness is independent across features and time. Using data from a person with epilepsy recorded on a Garmin smartwatch, we develop an evaluation protocol that mines contiguous missing-run templates from training data, stratifies them by per-feature gap-length quantiles, and injects them as block masks with preserved co-missingness structure. translated_title: 评估可穿戴设备数据上的深度多变量插补模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24436v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：可穿戴设备数据支持连续健康监测，但存在结构化缺失问题：共享同一物理传感器的特征会同时丢失。深度插补方法如BRITS和SAITS在现实缺失条件下对多模态生理数据的评估有限，现有基准采用随机点式留出协议，该协议错误地假设缺失在特征和时间上是独立的。利用一位癫痫患者在Garmin智能手表上记录的数据，我们开发了一种评估协议，该协议从训练数据中挖掘连续的缺失运行模板，按每个特征的间隙长度分位数进行分层，并将其作为保留共缺失结构的块掩码注入。一种匹配的训练协议使模型暴露于相同的缺失分布，将BRITS的严重间隙平均绝对误差降低了43%，证明了在此单一场景中提出的评估和训练协议的潜在益处。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于真实可穿戴数据中结构化缺失模式的新评估与训练协议，显著提升了深度插补模型在严重缺失场景下的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel evaluation and training protocol based on realistic structured missingness patterns in wearable data, significantly improving deep imputation model performance under severe gaps.
